issues.quote: "At eighteen minutes past ten by my watch I heard a thump on the floor right above me. In the atelier. Then my uncle's repeater."
issues.fact: F3 gives the thump at 10:18 by Félix's watch, followed by the repeater. The 10:21 descent (F4) is only said to be later than the 10:15 ascent. The sheet does not place the 10:21 event relative to the thump.
issues.misreading: Before this line the transcript narrates the 10:21 descent, then the interviewer says "Go on". A solver could read the thump as coming after the 10:21 descent, which would change the sequence of movements on the stairs. The explicit 10:18 reading resolves it, but the narration order invites the wrong sequence.

issues.quote: "He had been four years on that watch and he played it for anyone who would sit still."
issues.fact: The fact sheet gives no duration for how long the uncle has owned or used the repeater.
issues.misreading: The "four years" hint could be used as a timeline fact about the watch's history or the uncle's habits that the sheet does not support.

issues.quote: "It has given me trouble for ten years and I have never let anyone near it"
issues.fact: The sheet says nothing about how long Félix's watch has given trouble.
issues.misreading: The ten-year figure is an extra duration. A solver might link it to other time spans in the case.

issues.quote: "I was alone in the library, Inspector, directly under his bench."
issues.fact: F3 says only that the thump was on the floor right above the library, in the atelier. It does not mention a bench or where in the atelier the sound came from.
issues.misreading: "Directly under his bench" places the sound at a specific fixture in the uncle's workspace, a location detail the sheet does not provide.
